Introduction

Jia Hao is a Chinese trainee under Chromosome Entertainment. He is a member of the project group ALPHA DRIVE ONE.

He is best known for competing in the 2024 survival show Make Mate 1, where he made it to the finale, as well as the 2025 survival show Boys II Planet, where he ranked 5th.
